chat1_only.why: knows only chat 1: tied players share the lowest place of their group (1, 3, 3, 4), not the average

chat2_only.why: knows only chat 2's average places: players on 0 points are listed, and every player makes the board

top5_splits_ties.why: cuts the board at exactly 5 players, splitting a tie at 5th

competition_rank.why: gives tied players the first place of their group (1, 2, 2, 4), the usual sports ranking

cut_by_rank.why: keeps ranks 5 and better, so players tied at 5th, averaged to 5.5, all drop off the board
